tests.name: rollup-basics
tests.quote: 그래서 상세 행 뒤에 소계가 오고 총계는 맨 끝에 온다.
input: CREATE TABLE orders (region STRING, item STRING, qty INT)
INSERT INTO orders VALUES ('east', 'pen', 3), ('east', 'ink', 2), ('west', 'pen', 5), ('east', 'pen', 4)
SELECT region, SUM(qty) FROM orders GROUP BY ROLLUP(region)
SELECT region, item, COUNT(*), SUM(qty) FROM orders GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, item)

tests.name: cube-and-grouping-sets
tests.quote: GROUP BY 에 나온 열을 처음 나온 순서대로 늘어놓은 것이 그 질의의 그룹 열이다.
input: CREATE TABLE trips (city STRING, mode STRING, year INT, km INT)
INSERT INTO trips VALUES ('seoul', 'bus', 2023, 10), ('seoul', 'car', 2024, 30), ('busan', 'bus', 2024, 20), ('seoul', 'bus', 2024, 5), ('busan', 'car', 2023, 15)
SELECT city, mode, SUM(km) FROM trips GROUP BY CUBE(city, mode)
SELECT city, mode, COUNT(*) FROM trips GROUP BY CUBE(mode, city)
SELECT year, city, SUM(km) FROM trips GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (year, (city, year), ())
SELECT city, mode, year, COUNT(*) FROM trips GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((mode), (city), (year))
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM trips GROUP BY ROLLUP(city, zone)
SELECT mode, COUNT(*) FROM trips GROUP BY CUBE(city, town)
SELECT city, SUM(mode) FROM trips GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((city), (region)) ORDER BY zone

tests.name: real-null-and-subtotal
tests.quote: 빠진 열의 열 이름 항목은 NULL 이므로 그 키에서는 진짜 NULL 과 같다.
input: CREATE TABLE staff (dept STRING, team STRING, pay INT)
INSERT INTO staff VALUES ('dev', 'web', 10), (NULL, 'ops', 20), ('dev', NULL, 30), (NULL, NULL, 40), ('hr', 'ops', 50)
SELECT dept, team, GROUPING(dept), GROUPING(team), SUM(pay) FROM staff GROUP BY ROLLUP(dept, team)
SELECT dept, GROUPING(dept), COUNT(*) FROM staff GROUP BY ROLLUP(dept) ORDER BY dept NULLS FIRST
SELECT dept, team, SUM(pay) FROM staff GROUP BY CUBE(dept, team) ORDER BY team DESC, dept
SELECT team, GROUPING(team), COUNT(*) FROM staff GROUP BY ROLLUP(team) ORDER BY GROUPING(team) DESC, team

tests.name: rollup-report-ordering
tests.quote: 값이 NULL 인 행은 그 열이 빠진 행보다 앞선다.
input: CREATE TABLE sales (region STRING, city STRING, item STRING, qty INT)
INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('kr', 'seoul', 'pen', 5), ('kr', 'busan', 'pen', 2), ('kr', 'seoul', 'ink', 1)
INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('jp', 'tokyo', 'pen', 4), ('jp', 'osaka', 'ink', 3), ('kr', 'seoul', 'pen', 6), ('kr', NULL, 'ink', 2)
SELECT region, city, item, SUM(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, city, item)
SELECT region, city, SUM(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, city) ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT region, city, GROUPING(city), SUM(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, city) ORDER BY GROUPING(city) DESC, SUM(qty) DESC
SELECT item, region, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY CUBE(item, region) ORDER BY region NULLS FIRST, item DESC
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(city) ORDER BY city DESC NULLS LAST

tests.name: cube-all-subsets
tests.quote: `CUBE ( c1 , … , cn )` 은 c1, …, cn 의 부분집합 2^n 개를 모두 그룹 집합으로 적은 GROUPING SETS 와 같다.
input: CREATE TABLE t (a STRING, b STRING, c INT, v INT)
INSERT INTO t VALUES ('x', NULL, 1, 1), ('x', NULL, 2, 2), ('y', 'p', 1, 3), ('y', 'q', NULL, 4)
SELECT a, b, c, GROUPING(a), GROUPING(b), GROUPING(c), SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY CUBE(a, b, c)
SELECT a, b, SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a), (a, b))
SELECT b, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((b), ())
SELECT c, a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP(c, a) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c DESC

tests.name: empty-grouping-set
tests.quote: 빈 그룹 집합은 1단계 4.26 처럼 통과한 행 전체를 그룹 하나로 삼고 통과한 행이 없어도 결과 행 하나를 낸다.
input: CREATE TABLE logs (app STRING, lvl STRING, n INT)
SELECT app, COUNT(*), SUM(n) FROM logs GROUP BY ROLLUP(app)
SELECT app, lvl, GROUPING(app), COUNT(*) FROM logs GROUP BY CUBE(app, lvl)
SELECT app, COUNT(*) FROM logs GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((app), (lvl))
INSERT INTO logs VALUES ('api', 'warn', 3), ('web', 'info', 1)
SELECT app, COUNT(*), MIN(n), AVG(n) FROM logs WHERE n > 10 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((app), ())
SELECT lvl, COUNT(*), MAX(n) FROM logs WHERE n > 10 GROUP BY lvl
SELECT app, COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE n > 10 GROUP BY ROLLUP(app) LIMIT 0
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(n) FROM logs GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (())
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logs WHERE n > 10 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (())
SELECT app, SUM(n) FROM logs GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((), app)

input: CREATE TABLE sales (region STRING, item STRING, qty INT)
INSERT INTO sales VALUES ('east', 'pen', 3), ('west', 'ink', 4)
SELECT region, GROUPING(region), SUM(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY region
SELECT GROUPING(item), COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY region
SELECT COUNT(*), GROUPING(region) FROM sales
SELECT GROUPING(zone) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region)
SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region) ORDER BY GROUPING(region)
SELECT GROUPING(*) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region)
SELECT GROUPING(region, item) FROM sales GROUP BY CUBE(region, item)
SELECT item, GROUPING(region), COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region)
SELECT GROUPING(region), item FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region)
SELECT region, SUM(region) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(region)
SELECT GROUPING(item), region FROM sales GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region), (item))
SELECT GROUPING(region), GROUPING(item), COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region), (item)) ORDER BY GROUPING(item), GROUPING(region) DESC
SELECT SUM(qty), GROUPING(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY ROLLUP(qty)
SELECT GROUPING(item), GROUPING(item), COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY CUBE(item) ORDER BY GROUPING ( item ) DESC

tests.name: grouping-set-syntax
tests.quote: GROUPING SETS 에 열의 집합이 같은 그룹 집합을 두 번 쓰는 것도 문법 오류다.

SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a), (a))

SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY CUBE()
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ()
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY a, ROLLUP(b)
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP(a), CUBE(b)
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP(a), b
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY (a)
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS a
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP a
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY rollup(a)
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a), ((b)))
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a),)
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING (a)
SELECT a, b, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a, b), (a), (b), ())
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP ( a )
SELECT a, COUNT(*) FROM t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS(a,())
